versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the "design-handoff-brief" skill.  
- Converts feature briefs or PRDs into structured, actionable design briefs for designers.
- Output includes user goals, emotional context, success criteria, constraints, edge cases, and out-of-scope boundaries.
- Designed to help designers understand context and constraints before starting work.
- Built-in quality checks and anti-pattern warnings to ensure clear, user-centered handoffs.
